title: Concept: Redis Commander UI in a response
description: A Redis Commander web UI in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The UI browses and edits every key in the instance it connects to, including session caches and rate-limit counters, and it usually runs without authentication.
applicability: Deployments that render a Redis Commander web UI into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The UI browses and edits every key in the instance it connects to, including session caches and rate-limit counters, and it usually runs without authentication.
